brief:
Palestinian journalist Farah Abu Ayyash returned home to her family following 450 days in Israeli prisons, the Islamic Republic News Agency reported. Abu Ayyash's release came after she completed her detention period.

The journalist's case drew international attention during her imprisonment, as her extended detention raised concerns among press freedom advocates about the treatment of Palestinian media workers in Israeli custody.
dek: Palestinian journalist returns home after 15 months in Israeli detention Palestinian journalist Farah Abu Ayyash has returned home to her family following 450 days of detention in Israeli prisons, according to a report by the Islamic Republic News Agency…
title: Palestinian journalist freed after 15 months in Israeli detention
